declared_evidence_request.detail: Source shows optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) each step; loss is mean squared error over [batch, width]. Microbatch equivalence would require per-chunk weighting by valid element count divided by total N, single optimizer.step, scheduler step, and gradient reset at original effective-update boundary. Cross-sample ops (LayerNorm/GELU) may prevent equivalence. Need explicit confirmation of loss reduction semantics and that no cross-sample coupling exists.

final_evidence_requests.detail: Source shows effective_batch_per_optimizer_update=24 but policy allows batch/accumulation changes; need runtime confirmation that microbatch chunks preserve single optimizer step, scheduler step, gradient reset, and loss weighting by valid element count over total N.

Source shows backwards_per_optimizer_update=1; any microbatch plan must preserve exactly one backward per optimizer step without introducing multiple backwards that are not multiple optimizer updates.
